jobs.title: Business Operations Senior Manager
jobs.why: Fresh health-tech operations role owning daily operational performance, backlogs/TAT, scalable cross-functional workflows, vendor coordination, continuous improvement, and AI/automation opportunities. Kevin’s healthcare operations, workflow design, intake/process ownership, and automation work map well.
jobs.gap: Requires 6+ years of business operations or operational leadership and prefers 2+ years in health tech/digital health; payment integrity and Medicare Advantage are also domain stretches.

jobs.title: Digital Program Manager
jobs.why: Strong healthcare-tech match with a realistic 3–6 year experience band: client implementations, onboarding, milestones, requirements, reporting, data validation, process improvement, documentation and cross-functional delivery.
jobs.gap: Healthcare-data/interoperability depth and analytics tooling are the main gaps. SQL should be presented only as foundational/working knowledge.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare-benefits implementation role leading customers from planning through launch, with training, customer data, integrations, risk management and cross-functional execution. Healthcare experience is helpful rather than mandatory.
jobs.gap: Direct ICHRA/benefits implementation experience is missing, and compensation only clears Kevin’s $100K target in the upper part of the range.

jobs.title: Platform Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare SaaS implementation role centered on enterprise projects, requirements, client workgroups, process improvement, risk management and cross-functional coordination; the 3–5 year project-management range is comparatively accessible.
jobs.gap: Epic/Cerner, healthcare systems integration and data-integration experience are explicit requirements and represent a meaningful technical stretch.

jobs.title: Clinical Speciality Programs & Operations Manager - NY
jobs.why: Direct healthcare-operations fit across intake/referral workflows, SOPs, operational playbooks, KPIs, staffing models and process optimization. Kevin’s intake operations and healthcare workflow experience are highly relevant.
jobs.gap: Requires 5+ years in healthcare operations/clinical program management plus strong EHR, financial/P&L, analytics and Lean/Six Sigma depth; five-day onsite schedule is also restrictive.
